title: 第21章 阴曹地府照样可以打劫第22章 太白金星下界欲招安
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: 黑白无常带着楚云，来到了黄泉路上。
在黄泉路上看到了无数魂魄，被阴差押着前行。
“这么多人阴差，我还以为就你们两个人干活呢？”
楚云看向了一旁的白无常。
白无常虽然脸色苍白，但是整体面容还是清秀些。
“怎么可能，只有我们兄弟两人，要是那样，我们兄弟两人岂不是累死了！”
白无常比较健谈。
一路上逐渐成为了个大喇叭。
而黑无常则是板着脸。
“我说我们这样什么时候才能到达阎罗殿？”
此时黑无常终于开口说道了。
“大概需要6个时辰，你这么快想去阎罗殿受罪吗？”
六个时辰？
楚云直接跳了起来。
然后抓住黑白无常的衣领向前飞去。
这个操作直接惊呆了黑白无常。
三人如此行径，直接吓蒙了周围的鬼魂和阴差。
“跑这么快，急着投胎啊！”
一名阴差捡起了地上被阴风刮掉的帽子。
片刻钟后
三人来到了阎罗殿。
此时白无常脸色狰狞，黑无常脸色吓得煞白。
就算是再蠢，也知道招惹到了什么样的存在。
能够在地府当中畅行无阻，最起码也得是金仙以上实力。
此时阎罗王刚好从天庭返回。
一副忧心忡忡的样子。
“阎罗王何必忧心忡忡？！”
判官不解的问道。
“刚才玉皇大帝命，我划掉了一人的阳寿！”
对于这种事情，判官并没有感觉到有什么疏漏之处。
“500多年前，陛下吩咐了我同样的事情，我把那孙悟空抓了回来………”
接下来的事情，阎罗王即使不说，在场的阴差鬼官也知道什么。
齐天大圣，大闹地府。
忽然间。
阎罗殿大门打开。
两道身影从外面扑了进来。
content_en:
Black and white Wuchang took Chu Yun to Huangquan Road.
I saw countless souls on the road to hell, and were escorted forward by evil spirits.
"There are so many people doing evil things, I thought you two were the only ones doing the work?"
Chu Yun looked at Bai Wuchang beside him.
Although Bai Wuchang is pale, his overall face is still more delicate.
"How is it possible? There are only two of us brothers. If that were the case, wouldn't we two brothers be exhausted to death?"
Bai Wuchang is more talkative.
It gradually became a big speaker along the way.
Hei Wuchang, on the other hand, kept a straight face.
"I said, when can we reach the Yama Palace like this?"
At this time, Hei Wuchang finally spoke.
"It will take about 6 hours. Do you want to go to the Yama Palace to suffer so soon?"
Six hours?
Chu Yun jumped up immediately.
Then he grabbed the collar of Black and White and flew forward.
This operation directly shocked Black and White.
The three people acted like this, which directly frightened the ghosts and underworld around them.
"Running so fast, you are in a hurry to reincarnate!"
A bad guy picked up the hat that had been blown off by the wind.
a moment later
The three of them arrived at the Yama Hall.
At this time, Bai Wuchang's face was ferocious, and Hei Wuchang's face turned pale with fear.
No matter how stupid you are, you still know what kind of existence you are provoking.
To be able to travel unimpeded in the underworld, one must at least have the strength of a Golden Immortal or above.
At this time, King Yama just returned from heaven.
He looked worried.
"Why should King Yama be worried?!"
the judge asked in confusion.
"Just now the Jade Emperor ordered me to cross out someone's life span!"
Regarding this kind of thing, the judge did not feel that there was any omission.
"More than 500 years ago, His Majesty told me the same thing, and I captured the Sun Wukong..."
Even if King Yama didn't tell what happened next, the evil officials present would know what happened.
The Monkey King is making a big fuss in the underworld.
suddenly.
The gate of Yama Palace opens.
Two figures rushed in from outside.
